description: Move this company's local MCP data (saved booking and annual-report rules, plus local state: statement balances, receipt digests, CAMT acknowledgements, limited-VAT settings, Lightyear USD pool) to another machine or a new API key. export = write one .json file (new file only, 0600; no credentials). import = dry run (per file new / identical / differs, row-level rule diffs, state record counts) → owner approval → execute:true + plan_handle. Refused for another company (company_mismatch). Existing state is never overwritten unless named in replace_state_stores; a differing rule file is written only when named in apply_rule_files. Nothing is changed in e-arveldaja.

apply_rule_files.description: import: rule files (paths as listed by the dry run) whose imported version replaces a differing local one

execute.description: import: false (default) = dry run; true = execute an approved plan_handle

file_path.description: Absolute path. export: the new .json file to write; import: the export file to read

plan_handle.description: import with execute:true: the handle from the dry run

replace_state_stores.description: import: state stores whose existing records for this company are replaced by the imported ones

name: accounting_data_transfer
title: Export / Import Company Data
